use_case: AI offers and markdown suggestions (SYS-10): suggests personalized weekly loyalty offers from purchase history, and markdown or regular price changes for items based on sell-by date, stock, cost, and sales
vendor_or_model: Payment and commerce platform provider (built-in machine learning recommendation and pricing feature)
data_categories: Loyalty purchase history and visit frequency; item cost, price, stock, sell-by date, and sales velocity. Tender type (including SNAP EBT) excluded from segments since 2026-08-26
consequential_decision_category: None (retail prices and discounts; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Owner approves each offer campaign; Store Manager approves every regular price change; Stock and Produce Clerk approves near-date markdowns within set limits; nothing takes effect without a person accepting it
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (N44-45-R02); 7 CFR 278.2(b) equal treatment of SNAP customers; Fla. Stat. 501.160 during a declared state of emergency; privacy notice commitments
status: In production; approved with conditions 2026-08-31 (tender-based segments and provider model-improvement data sharing turned off 2026-08-26)

use_case: Public generative AI chatbot used by the Owner to draft product descriptions, weekly ad text, and social media posts
vendor_or_model: Public consumer generative AI chatbot (free tier)
data_categories: Product names, prices, and promotions only; no customer, loyalty, employee, or supplier cost data
human_in_the_loop: Owner edits every draft; claims checked against the claims checklist before publishing
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (claims in published text) (N44-45-R02)
status: Approved 2026-08-31 for use without Restricted data (POL-04 4.8)
